notes: BancoPosta "ListaMovimenti.xlsx" (Excel or PDF from the site; the semicolon CSV of ofxstatement-bancoposta is a 2018 form). Sheet "ListaMovimenti"; column A rows 2-10 hold " da: (gg/mm/aaaa): …", " a: …", " Tipo(operazioni): …", " Conto BancoPosta n.: …", " Intestato a: …", " Saldo al: …", " Saldo contabile: +2.469,50 Euro", " Saldo disponibile: …" (leading spaces as ZeeD writes them back); header on row 12: Data Contabile | Data Valuta | Addebiti (euro) | Accrediti (euro) | Descrizione operazioni; data from row 13. Dates are date cells; debits are POSITIVE numbers in Addebiti, credits in Accrediti. Row 1 and row 5 contents are not documented (placeholder title / blank). Order assumed newest first. Closing = Saldo contabile at "Saldo al"; no opening stated.
